info.name: MzaziCare API
info.description:
Every endpoint of the MzaziCare API, grouped so the folders can be run top to bottom.

Import this with the environment file beside it and choose that environment. Run **1. Sign in** first: it signs in every seeded account and saves their tokens, so every other request is already authorised. Tokens last 15 minutes; run it again when requests start answering 401.

Full guide: docs/api-testing.md

exec: pm.test('database and Redis are both up', () => {

item.name: 1. Sign in
item.description: Signs in each seeded account and saves its token to the environment. Run the whole folder before anything else, and again when requests start answering 401 (tokens last 15 minutes).

request.description: Each refresh token works once. Running this twice with the same token signs the caregiver out everywhere, which is the replay protection working; run **Caregiver** sign-in again to recover.

item.name: 2. An emergency, start to finish
item.description: Run in order. The elder raises an alert, the caregiver sees it, takes it on and closes it.

request.description: Empty body: the server works out where the elder is. Saves the new alert's id as alertId.

exec: pm.test('the new alert is in the list', () => {
pm.test('carries the chain and the trail', () => {

request.description: Outcomes: FALSE_ALARM, CANCELLED_BY_ELDER, HANDLED_AT_HOME, RESPONDER_ATTENDED, HOSPITAL_TRANSFER, NO_RESPONSE, OTHER. OTHER needs a note: { "outcome": "OTHER", "note": "..." }.

item.name: 3. Declining moves it on
item.description: Run in order. The caregiver cannot come, so tier two is asked at once; the family member takes it on, calls in a responder and closes it.

request.description: Only somebody asked at the current tier may decline.

item.name: Family member calls in a responder
4. Withdrawing and reopening
item.description: Run in order and quickly: an elder can only withdraw inside the 10 second grace window.

request.description: Refused with 409 after the grace window or once somebody has taken it on.
For a withdrawn alert nobody could confirm. The chain starts again.

item.name: Caregiver closes it with a note
5. Signing up
item.description: Needs one value you type yourself: the code. Send the first request, find the code in the terminal running the API (a line ending 'is your MzaziCare code'), put it in the environment's `code` variable, then send the second.

request.description: Always 202, whether or not a code was sent, so the endpoint cannot reveal who is registered. One code per number every 30 seconds.
role is CAREGIVER or FAMILY_MEMBER. A wrong or expired code answers 400. Each newPhone can sign up once; change it to sign up again.

item.name: 6. Elders and their chains
item.description: Uses the account made in 5. Registering an elder needs a second code, sent to the elder's number.

request.description: Goes through the API to OpenStreetMap Nominatim, which allows one search a second for everybody. Do not run it in a loop. Saves the first match as the home for the next request.

item.name: Send a code to the elder's phone

request.description: Put the code from the API terminal into elderCode first. careLevel is INDEPENDENT, ASSISTED or HIGH_DEPENDENCY, or leave it out.
